announcements.title: Da co ban 1.1.0: doc nen + ma VIP
announcements.body: Ban moi giu truyen doc tiep khi tat man hinh, tu doc tiep sau quang cao, them muc nhap ma VIP o Cai dat.

announcements.title: Kho Co tich them 10 truyen moi
announcements.body: Da bo sung 10 truyen co tich. Mo Kho sach -> Lam moi de thay.

announcements.title: Tang 30 ma VIP thang cho doc gia moi
announcements.body: Nhap ma o Cai dat -> Ma VIP de xoa quang cao + mo giong Cloud. Nhanh tay, het dot se khoa.
